payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_spec_citations.py::test_a_citation_defect_with_no_single_span_is_left_and_its_text_kept stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'A held name with two spans rewritten to its first, so the `twin` citation of line 3 becomes `1-2`.' applied to saffron/spec_citations.py as an edit. The claim was "`rewrite_moved_citations` leaves every other defect, in text order, and leaves its citation's text as written. The witness drives each kind the check reports. The held map takes every offset whose clause names one, mapped to that name. That is a bare citation with no path, a start before line 1, an end before its start, a missing file and a range past a file's end. It also drives a held name that opens two spans. One rewritable citation among them is rewritten and is not left.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
